title: Task store v2 still refuses with "another process holds the task store lock"
body: From #10300 (07d8378aae, docs/worktrees/2026-10-03-git-lock-contention.md): task-store lock refusals still happen on store v2 (one file per task) — seen on coderos (`Coder did not start: another process holds the task store lock; retry after it exits` for #10239/#10248 in parallel chat work). Find which lock is still global under v2, make per-task operations not contend (or wait briefly instead of refusing), regression test with parallel starts.
